en.title: Help — how learn.kg works and where to start
en.desc: learn.kg help: how to get access and sign in, Kyrgyz courses A1–B2, the phrasebook, phrase translator and level test with no sign-in, app install, contacts.
en.lead: Everything about learn.kg on one page: where to start, what lives where, how to get access and whom to ask.

items: Flashcards with audio, a pronunciation lesson, drills and a mini-quiz — try the trainer without signing up.
15 questions — find your level and where to begin.
The teacher opens access: login and password usually the same day. There is no sign-up form.
Alphabet, phonetics, 1073 phrases with native audio.
Systematic grammar: tenses, cases, 873 phrases, real topics.
Topic modules, tasks in Kyrgyz, revision and a final week.
Formal letters, argument and evaluation, articles and public speaking.
337 situational phrases, each with native-speaker audio.
Answers to “how do you say it in Kyrgyz”: the word, its variants, replies and audio.
Instant search across the course's 3726 phrases.
Articles on the alphabet, pronunciation, test preparation and study method.
The trainer installs on phone and computer: its own icon, full screen, works offline.
Your login works on any device; progress is shared and stored on the server.

faq.q: How do I get access to the courses?
faq.a: Message Altynai on WhatsApp (+996 505 854 856) — she will create your login and password, usually the same day. There is no sign-up form.

faq.q: I forgot my password. What now?
faq.a: Message Altynai on WhatsApp — she will set a new one. Once signed in, you can change your password in the trainer settings.

faq.q: Will my progress survive a device change?
faq.a: Yes: progress is tied to your login and lives on the server. Phone on the road, laptop at home — the same review queue.

faq.q: What is available without signing in?
faq.a: The phrasebook with audio, the phrase translator, the level test, the demo lesson with a pronunciation lesson, and all blog articles.

faq.q: Where do I report bugs and ideas?
faq.a: WhatsApp Altynai or Instagram @learnkg_edu — we read everything and fix quickly: corrections reach all students at once.

Resmî mektup, argüman ve değerlendirme, makale ve topluluk önünde konuşma.
